mapper.sql: tsi.id, tsi.transfer_type, tsi.source_warehouse_id, tsi.target_warehouse_id, tsi.grain_variety, tsi.estimated_quantity, tsi.start_time, tsi.end_time, tsi.transfer_reason, tsi."status", tsi.add_user, tsi.add_time, tsi.update_user, tsi.update_time
mapper.select: select, sw1.warehouse_name as source_warehouse_name, sw2.warehouse_name as target_warehouse_name, bui.name as add_user_name from sts_transfer_storage_info tsi left join sts_warehouse sw1 on tsi.source_warehouse_id = sw1.id left join sts_warehouse sw2 on tsi.target_warehouse_id = sw2.id left join base_user_info bui on tsi.add_user = bui.id where tsi.id = #{id}
